shared_elements: shallow/low relief carving on a tall vertical stone slab
small circular disc or rosette motif
horizontal band or register line dividing the field
limbs/arms rendered with hands and clawlike digits
justification: Both are tall vertical stone panels carved in low relief with profile-oriented figures, band-like dividing lines and a small disc/rosette element, which is the most specific correspondence. But A stacks small, schematic, flattened animal and disc motifs in tiers over the whole surface, while B is dominated by one or two large, anatomically modelled human-form figures with dense fine detailing, so the compositional logic and the technical refinement are quite different.
